use_cases: Staggered entrance animations for lists and grids of items
Scroll-triggered reveal animations for content sections
Orchestrating multiple element transitions with preset effects
Creating engaging page load and route transition animations
Building interactive card and component entrance sequences
ai_summary: A flexible animation orchestration component that wraps child elements and applies preset motion effects with staggered timing. Provides 10 built-in animation presets including fade, slide, scale, blur, zoom, flip, bounce, rotate, and swing, with configurable container and item variants using Framer Motion. Ideal for creating polished entrance animations, scroll-triggered reveals, and coordinated multi-element transitions.
